title.en: The One With the Trip to Madrid

description.es: Fina y Marta hablan sobre Jaime. Fina le pregunta a Marta si se ha acostado con Jaime. Jaime llega y le habla a Marta de su plan de ir a Madrid. Al oírlo, Fina se molesta, y ella y Marta discuten. Al final, Marta se deja llevar y convence a Fina de ir a Madrid, y se ponen en camino. Justo cuando entran en el piso, llega Jaime.
description.en: Fina and Marta talk about Jaime. Fina asks Marta whether she has slept with Jaime. Jaime arrives and tells Marta about his plan to go to Madrid. Hearing this, Fina becomes upset, and she and Marta argue. In the end, Marta gets carried away and persuades Fina to go to Madrid, and they set off. Just as they walk into the apartment, Jaime arrives.
